passages.note: Senate concurrence floor vote on SB 100; Stern voted Aye.

passages.provision_quote: It is the policy of the state that eligible renewable energy resources and zero-carbon resources supply 100 percent of all retail sales of electricity to California end-use customers and 100 percent of electricity procured to serve all state agencies by December 31, 2045.
passages.note: Chaptered bill text setting the RPS mandate and 100% clean-energy-by-2045 policy that Stern's vote enacted.

rows.reasoning: Henry Stern voted Aye on SB 100 (2017-2018)'s Senate concurrence vote (Ayes Count 25, Noes Count 13), a single-subject clean-energy bill whose operative provisions set a 60% Renewables Portfolio Standard by December 31, 2030 and a state policy that renewable/zero-carbon resources supply 100 percent of retail electricity sales by December 31, 2045. These are mandates with firm deadlines, matching the rung text 'Require a shift to clean energy through mandates and firm deadlines.'
